entities.summary: Jonathan Benjamin Edwards is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers, San Diego Padres, and Cleveland Indians. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers.
